events.title: The Eternal Blade Demo Is Live!
events.summary: Two Devs. 4 Years of Lore.It has been two of us building this world for four years, from the anime screenplay to the manga, and now you can finally play in it. The demo gives you about an hour of the main quest, closer to three if you take your time exploring, and it covers the heart of what Eternal Blade is: parry-driven combat that feeds your Almighty power, five bosses, an open world with side quests, puzzles, enemy camps, and plenty worth finding off the path. events.title: The Demo Is Ready. The Page Isn't.
events.summary: Quick update from the two of us. The demo is done. The build passed Steam's review, and it's sitting there ready to go. What we're waiting on is the demo's store page, which is still in Valve's review queue. Until they approve it, we can't flip the switch, and there's no button we can press to make that go faster. events.title: Eternal Blade Demo - Soon!
events.summary: Demo is coming soon!We're glad to announce that the Eternal Blade Demo is launching the week of October 5th! This really means a lot to us, and we are very excited to have other people play it. We hope you guys enjoy it and can't wait to hear your thoughts! Thank you to everyone who's been following the game and supporting us so far. ❤️

events.title: Eternal Blade Playtest Began! September 4th - 15th
events.summary: The playtest is now live!After a lot of work, we're finally opening the game up for players to jump in and experience it for themselves.This build is still a work in progress, but it includes a good look at what we're building — from exploration and combat to the world, enemies, weapons, and progression.Your feedback is genuinely useful at this stage.
